candidates.name: confusion_lesson_memory
candidates.hypothesis: For each wrong prediction, calling the LLM once to distill a corrective lesson ('when you see X prefer Y over Z because...') and injecting the top-k most similar lessons as an explicit advisory section in the prompt will reduce fine-grained charge confusion errors that raw Q/A examples cannot encode as explicit rules.

candidates.name: mmr_diversity_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Replacing Jaccard top-k retrieval with Maximal Marginal Relevance (lam=0.6) will reduce multi-label omissions by ensuring the retrieved example set spans multiple charge families rather than clustering around one neighbourhood, giving the LLM at least one multi-charge exemplar when the query facts describe concurrent behaviours.
